units.text: This chapter tops up a strength your chart has always run short of. You get the most from it among equals, in teams and contests where you can measure yourself.

This decade brings {el}, your own energy, and your chart has gone short of it. You stand straighter at work and among peers, and you hold your ground where you once gave it away. The price is sharing credit with equals, and you find you can afford it.
These years brought {el}, a strength your chart was short of, with games and teams at school. You learned early that you could hold your own among other children.
These years brought {el} through brothers, sisters or cousins close in age. You learned to stand up for your share at the family table, and you never quite stopped.
These years brought {el} and the company of equals, colleagues and friends who matched your pace. You found a firmness in yourself that had been missing before.
These years brought more {el}, a stretch when you stopped waiting for permission. You struck out on your own terms, and you held a position against people who doubted you.
This decade brings {el} and a sturdier sense of yourself. You stand by your own judgement at work and at home, and you need less approval than before.
This decade brings more {el} through friends and rivals who keep you sharp. You compete more openly than you used to, and you win more often than you lose.

This decade brings {el}, a surplus of your own energy, and it makes you stubborn with your equals. Peers at work want the same ground you do. Hard and useful work carries you through, and you end the decade proud of what you made.
These years brought more {el} than a child could hold, and you squared up to brothers, sisters and classmates. Sport gave the strength an outlet, and you learned to win without a fight.
These years brought {el}, and a stubborn streak that pushed against the grown-ups at home. An older relative who gave you real jobs to do saw you through, and you grew proud of finishing them.
These years brought {el} to spare, and peers who wanted the same things as you. Work you could make your own kept you level, and you turned rivalry into a standard to beat.
These years brought {el} into a chart already full of it, and you went it alone more than you needed to. A clear role with firm rules steadied you, and you learned to share the load.

This decade brings {el} beyond what your chart needs, and it sets you against people who want the same prize. Making something with your hands or your voice carries you, and you spend the surplus where it shows.
This decade brings {el} again, with a habit of holding on to your own way at home. A partner who stands as your equal bears you up, and you find that yielding costs less than it seems.
This chapter feeds you with learning, help and rest. You draw the most from it through slow study and the people who back you.

This decade brings {el}, the Mind your chart has gone without, with study and people who look out for you. A mentor or a course opens a door you had walked past. You learn faster than you expected, and you rest without guilt for the first time in years.
These years brought {el}, and a teacher or a book that opened the world to you. You learned that questions were welcome, and you kept asking them.
These years brought {el} through an older relative who looked after you. Someone in your first home made you feel safe, and you rested in that care.
These years brought {el} through study, a course or a training that finally fitted. You gained a way of thinking that you still use.
These years brought more {el}, a stretch of shelter after a harder time, with someone who backed you and asked little in return. You recovered your footing, and you trusted help again.
This decade brings {el} and the chance to study something for its own sake. You read, ask and reflect more, and you come out of it wiser about your own life.
This decade brings more {el}, with mentors and helpers who show up when you need them. You accept support more easily than before, and you rest well.
This chapter wraps you in more thought and shelter than you can use. Practical work and plain effort spend it well, and you feel lighter when your hands are busy.

This decade brings {el}, more Mind than your chart can use, with plans that stay plans and help you never asked for. You think a step too long before each move. Practical work carries you through, and you find your footing by doing one thing at a time.
These years brought more {el} than a child needed, with grown-ups who did the things you could already do yourself. Friends and outdoor games carried you, and you found out what you could do alone.
These years brought {el} as a comfortable shelter that made it easy to stay put. A job with real stakes pulled you out, and you discovered you were braver than you thought.
This decade brings {el} and more advice than you can use, from people who mean well. Hands-on work and plain targets carry you, and you trust your own reading of things.
This decade brings {el} again, with endless reading and plans that stall before they start. A practical partner or a deadline keeps you moving, and you finish more than you begin.
This chapter opens an outlet your chart has long been short of. You make the most of it whenever your talent has an audience, at work or among friends.

This decade brings {el}, the Expression your chart has waited for, with work you make and a voice people listen to. Your talent finds an audience among colleagues and friends. You enjoy more and worry less, and you share your work without asking first.
These years brought {el}, with drawing, music or games you made up yourself. You found something you were good at, and you showed it off gladly.
These years brought {el} and a louder voice at school, in class and in the playground. Someone in your first home enjoyed your stories, and you learned that you were worth hearing.
These years brought {el} and work that let you make things your own way. You found your style, and people began to ask for it.
These years brought more {el}, a lighter stretch of good food, good company and things done for pleasure. You laughed more than in the years before, and you spoke your mind more easily.
This decade brings more {el}, with a skill ready to be shown and people keen to learn it from you. You teach, make or perform, and you are paid in attention as well as thanks.
This chapter loosens your tongue past what your chart can carry. A craft that takes patience spends it well, and you keep your standing when your talent speaks for you.
These years brought {el} in a rush, with a quick tongue that got you into trouble in class. A teacher who gave you a stage carried you, and you learned to perform rather than argue.
These years brought {el} to a restless child who wanted to try everything at once. A patient older relative and one steady hobby kept you anchored, and you finished what you started.
These years brought {el} as a sharp voice at work, with friction from people above you. A craft that needed your full skill carried you, and you earned respect for the work rather than the words.
These years brought {el} through a spell of appetite and spending on whatever pleased you. Friends who kept you honest steadied you, and you kept the fun without losing your footing.
This decade brings {el}, and with it a voice that runs faster than your patience. One demanding project carries you, and you put the restlessness into something that lasts.
This decade brings {el} again, full of ideas you want to say aloud before they are ready. Study under someone you respect carries you, and you speak with more weight because of it.

This decade brings {el}, the Action your chart is hungry for, with work that pays and chances you can take hold of. Money comes in more steadily than before, and practical life gets easier. You reach further than you used to, and you keep most of what you gain.
These years brought {el}, with chores, errands and small jobs that earned you something. You learned that effort paid, and you liked the feeling.
These years brought {el} through trips, outings and things to explore beyond the front door. You came home with your hands full, and you wanted to go again.
These years brought {el} and a first real income, with a job that rewarded effort. You learned to handle money, and it stayed handled.
These years brought {el} as a stretch of ventures and practical wins. You took hold of chances others passed over, and several of them paid.
These years brought more {el} than a child could manage, with too many clubs and plans pulling you different ways. A close friend kept you steady, and you learned to choose one thing at a time.
These years brought {el} into a busy home where the grown-ups were always working and counting. A brother, sister or cousin kept you company, and you grew capable well before your age.
These years brought {el} to excess, with bills, offers and chances that all wanted your time. Your own stubborn strength carried you, and you dropped what did not matter.
These years brought {el} and the weight of practical life, a home to run and costs that kept climbing. Friends who pitched in held you up, and you came out leaner and surer of what counts.
This decade brings more {el}, with ventures and demands that pull you in many directions. Peers who share the load carry you, and you keep only the work that repays you.
This decade brings {el} again, and with it more to earn and more to spend. A firm sense of your own limits carries you, and you turn down the offers that cost more than they give.
This chapter gives your strength the shape it has lacked. Clear roles and firm deadlines bring out your best, and you rise when someone holds you to a standard.
These years brought {el}, with school rules and a teacher who expected a lot. You rose to it, and you liked being measured against a clear standard.
These years brought {el} through a job someone in your first home trusted you with. You took the duty seriously, and you grew up a little faster for it.
These years brought {el} and a role with a title, a place in a structure that suited you. You kept your word to the people above you, and they noticed.
These years brought more {el}, a stretch of reviews, deadlines and people keeping score. You did your best work under that pressure, and your name began to carry weight.
This decade brings {el} and a reputation that arrives before you do, with people who expect you to lead. You take charge more readily than before, and you wear the authority well.

This decade brings {el}, more Order than your chart can bear, with deadlines and people who judge your work. The pressure comes from every side at once. Study and the support of a mentor carry you through, and you come out of it steadier than you went in.
These years brought {el} as strict rules and grown-ups who were quick to correct you. A grandparent or a good book gave you shelter, and you found a corner of calm that belonged to you.
These years brought {el}, with tests and comparisons that weighed on you at school. A patient teacher helped you through, and you learned that slow was not the same as wrong.
These years brought {el} from above, a boss or a set of rules that left you little say. A course of study gave you somewhere to grow, and you outlasted the pressure.
These years brought {el} through obligations you never chose, roles that others expected you to fill. A friend who listened carried you through them, and you kept your own counsel.
This decade brings {el} as deadlines that stack up and people above you who want more. A quiet home and real rest carry you, and you meet the pressure fresher than those around you.

This decade brings {el} under a brighter spotlight, with your name on things and people watching how you handle them. Learning something new carries you through it, and you answer criticism with skill.
Under it ran {g}, which drew the {e} off, and you felt it soften as it went.
Under it ran more {g}, and you felt it at full strength.
Under it ran {g}, which the {e} held down, and you put both to work.
Under it ran {g}, which pushed back against the {e}, and you felt the two pull apart.
